typeHitEffects.tool: Made with PixelLab's free vfx_workbench (MCP), no paid generations. For each type a hand-written effect recipe (96x96 canvas, 6 frames @12fps one-shot; evolve 192x192, 8 frames) was rendered from the workbench's own layer types (glow, rays, ring, spiral, arc, bolt, noise, puffs, free shapes, particles incl. hand-drawn pixel sprites for leaves, ghosts, music notes), with colour ramps taken from the matching public/art/fxtype-<type>.png icon and a dark outline. Each was inspected frame by frame in the workbench and patched (sizes, timing, colour intensity, edge clipping), then exported (saved as 'Atlaswild <type> hit' in the user's PixelLab My effects, re-editable there) and the exported spritesheet PNG was sliced with PIL into per-frame RGBA PNGs with transparent background, effect origin at the canvas centre. Burst grows over frames 1-4, fades on 5, frame 6 (evolve: 8) is empty or a few specks.
